sections.Profile:
The "Gay Paree" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on January 3, 1957, is a four-player electro-mechanical game.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Travel, Singing, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
